messages.content: Call lookup_records and lookup_policy for the requested case before deciding. The action must be "investigate" when receipt_denied is true and days_since_delivery <= investigate_within_days; otherwise action must be "no_action". Copy refund_allowed from policy independently of the action. After BOTH results, output only a JSON object with case_id (string), action (string), refund_allowed (boolean). Derive all values from the tool results.
Check case A. Use both tools now.
